A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Molmo2 work, with 58 readable pages including Appendices A–I. Full-document text and rendered-page comparisons establish that differences are limited to the arXiv stamp and a funding acknowledgment.

before.justification: v1 reports original Molmo2 benchmark evaluations, human-preference results and training ablations in Section 4, with additional empirical results in Appendices C–E.

after.justification: v2 retains these original benchmark evaluations, human-preference results and ablations, including the additional appendix experiments.

M1.justification: The architecture, three-stage training, token weighting, packing, message-tree procedures and Appendix E SlowFast variants are unchanged.

E1.justification: Training datasets and evaluation coverage remain identical, including video understanding, pointing, tracking, image and multi-image tasks, human preferences and NLP benchmarks.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in every corresponding experiment, including proprietary APIs, Qwen3-VL, specialized tracking models and the base language models in Table 19.

E3.justification: The reported splits, sample sizes, training budgets, frame and crop limits, metrics, decoding settings and evaluation procedures are identical in the main text and appendices.

E4.justification: The component and data ablations, counting breakdowns, test-time scaling analyses and qualitative failure cases are retained unchanged, including Tables 8–11 and 16–20 and Figure 36.

E5.justification: Appendix C retains the same 1,000-round bootstrap procedure for Elo confidence intervals and Figure 5. No run, seed or uncertainty-reporting information changes.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings are unchanged. For example, Table 3 retains Molmo2-8B's 35.5 Molmo2-VC accuracy and 38.4 Molmo2-VP F1 in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical expressions and definitions, including token weighting, the packing optimization and grounding metrics, are identical. No assumptions, derivations or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about open models and data, nine new datasets, training innovations and understanding and grounding performance.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and Appendix H limitations are unchanged, including dependence on closed components, limited long-video grounding, repeated points and repetitive captions.

D1.justification: Implementation and preprocessing details, hyperparameters in Table 12, hardware and training times in Table 14, and model, data and code access links are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 5, the cited works and the reference list are identical. The added funding acknowledgment does not change research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 adds one sentence acknowledging National Science Foundation Award No. 2413244 on page 17 and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Research prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: All figures, tables, captions and their placement are identical, including appendix displays. The funding sentence occupies existing blank space on page 17 without rearranging the layout.

improvement.justification: v2 adds funding attribution and updates the arXiv stamp, while the scientific content, experimental evidence, limitations and reproducibility information remain identical throughout the main text and appendices. The acknowledgment improves attribution but does not meaningfully change overall paper quality.
